required_reader_corrections: Distinguish the three library dependencies from the printed parent Theorem 2.9. Historical Jensen compilation is not Jensen acceptance in this migration.

Give each helper its actual class scope: the AE equality helper uses CompleteSpace but no finite dimensionality or Borel structure on E; the geometric helper uses finite dimensionality and no probability; the barycenter terminal retains MeasurableSpace E and BorelSpace E.
Say a(X) equals a(mean X) almost everywhere, not that X or the functional map is constant. The supplied a may be zero; nonzero existence belongs only to the geometric helper.

Describe the geometric conclusion as non-strict support at level a(x), using ambient interior. Do not imply relative interior, strict separation, normalization, a(x)=0, or a closed/full-dimensional set.

Keep membership in s itself, genuine Integrable X and AE membership explicit; no closedness, boundedness, measurable-set, finite-support, or nonempty-interior premise. Attribute the centered kernel lift, null-set modification and local transparency option only to the barycenter proof, rather than copying them to both supporting helper notes.
